body.name: \(\mathcal K_0(Y_0)\)
body.construction: Compute \(S_0=T_0^{-1}Y_0Y_0^{\top}\), take its rank-\(r\) top-eigenspace projector \(\widehat P\) with the fixed tie rule, set \(V_0=2(N+1)\sigma_{\mathrm{hi}}^2rd_{\mathrm{hi}}^2+N(N+1)\sigma_{\mathrm{hi}}^4\) and \(\delta_0=\min\{1,2\sqrt{V_0/(T_0\alpha/2)}/d_{\mathrm{lo}}^2\}\), and return \(\mathcal K_0(Y_0)=\{P':P'^2=P'=P'^{\top},\operatorname{tr}(P')=r,\|P'-\widehat P\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\delta_0\}\).
